svg.title: Power11 in three of IBM's figures
svg.desc: Up to 256 Power11 cores and 64 TB of DDR5 memory in the Power E1180. Up to 120 Power11 cores and 16 TB of DDR5 memory in the 4U Power E1150. 2x the core performance of a Power S914 in the Power S1112, and 3x a Power S814, from published CPW results comparing 4-core systems, valid as of July 14, 2026.
